name: @johnpatrickwarren-oss/cairn
description: Structured RCA / postmortem attribution. Ranks candidate cause-events against an observed regression's onset by combining timestamp-alignment kernels, per-cause-kind priors, and evidence-quality boosts from DeploySignal / Tessera / Anvil audit streams. Closes the lifecycle loop: DS catches at gate-time, Tessera observes during steady state, Cairn attributes when something escapes both — statistically, not by eyeballing dashboards.
